# laravelforge_security_rule (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge security rule (HTTP basic-auth protection) on a site by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the security rule.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site the rule belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Security rule name.
- `path` (String) Protected path (null protects all routes).
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
